description: Keyword Explorer table filters and sort: the same cases run against the dashboard (web/src/components/KeywordResearch/explorer/keywordExplorerFilters.ts) and the cache-only research route (lambda/seo/seo-keywords.py explorer_rows), so the table and its export list the same rows in the same order. Filters use the dashboard's field names; the route reads them as include, exclude, min_volume, max_volume, max_difficulty, min_cpc, max_cpc, intents (comma separated), sort and direction.

cases.name: lists every row by volume, highest first, equal volumes in research order and unknown volume last
keeps only rows holding every include term
drops rows holding any exclude term and sorts keywords alphabetically ignoring case and accents
drops rows of unknown difficulty under a max difficulty
keeps rows from a minimum CPC, cheapest first
keeps rows of any chosen intent, keywords in reverse alphabetical order
keeps rows within the volume bounds, lowest competition first
lists unknown competition last when sorting by competition descending
